name: Kuriyama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kuriyama town emblem in red: a stylised chevron pointing to the hoist with a half disc.
history: Municipal flag of Kuriyama, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 19 June 1963.

features.role: Kuriyama town emblem — a stylised chevron pointing to the hoist with a half disc
